text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... My body feels so heavy...
Even though I went to the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...With all these consecutive races, we haven't been able to take proper care of your physical condition, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
A-Anyway, let's try other things too!
Like eating sweets, or going to a chiropractor!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta do something about this quickly
so I can rack up wins with Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Narita Top Road can't shake the fatigue
built up from consecutive races.
It would be best to review our schedule.
